dialogues.jp:
自分の存在を意識しながら地面を踏みしめて、
上目遣いにさくらを見上げる。
dialogues.en:
I stood strong on the ground realizing my own existence, and
cast an upward glance at Sakura.
dialogues.text:
I stood strong on the ground realizing my own existence, and
cast an upward glance at Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 身長差を考えても、かなり難しい行為だ。
dialogues.en:
It was quite difficult to do, since we have a huge
difference in height.
dialogues.text:
It was quite difficult to do, since we have a huge
difference in height.

dialogues.jp: 唇の端をゆがめてさくらが呟く。
dialogues.en: As she mumbled, the edge of her mouth twitched.
dialogues.text: As she mumbled, the edge of her mouth twitched.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、どうしようもない。音夢には俺の心が
　分かるんだ」
dialogues.en: "But I can't do anything. Nemu can read my mind."
dialogues.text: "But I can't do anything. Nemu can read my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「このままじゃ音夢ちゃん死んじゃうんだ
　よ！？」
dialogues.en: "She'll die if you keep doing this!!"
dialogues.text: "She'll die if you keep doing this!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それで止められるような気持ちじゃないんだ
　よ」
ふたりの間に沈黙が流れる。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "You can't take the usual route when it's this bad."
dialogues.text: "You can't take the usual route when it's this bad."

dialogues.jp: さくらの瞳を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Sakura complained as she put her hand on her forehead.
dialogues.text: Sakura complained as she put her hand on her forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「こうなると、普通の手段じゃどうにもならな
　いよ」
dialogues.en:
"It won't work to have Nemu-chan move off the island, since
it's really bad."
dialogues.text:
"It won't work to have Nemu-chan move off the island, since
it's really bad."

dialogues.jp: 顎に手を当ててさくらがぼやく。
dialogues.en: "Hold on. What did you say now?"
dialogues.text: "Hold on. What did you say now?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ここまで来ると、音夢ちゃんを島の外に逃が
　しても意味はないし……」

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て。今、なんて言った？」
dialogues.en: "I said, get Nemu-chan to move off the island......"
dialogues.text: "I said, get Nemu-chan to move off the island......"

dialogues.jp: はた、と何かが……何だろう？

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Ah...... I said you can't take the usual route......"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... I said you can't take the usual route......"

dialogues.jp: そこで、さくらが慌てて口をつむぐ。
dialogues.en: "Is there another route besides the usual route?"
dialogues.text: "Is there another route besides the usual route?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが強くかぶりを振った。
なにをそんなに怖がっているのか――。

「俺になにか悪い影響を与える方法があるんだ
　な」
dialogues.en: "There's a way to save her, but it has a bad effect on me?"
dialogues.text: "There's a way to save her, but it has a bad effect on me?"

dialogues.jp: それは疑問ではなかった。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ダメ！　絶対に言わないよ！」
肩を掴んで顔を下げる。
dialogues.en: I grabbed her shoulders and looked down.
dialogues.text: I grabbed her shoulders and looked down.

dialogues.jp: 色が変わるほど、さくらが唇を噛み締める。
dialogues.en: She bit her lip so hard that it changed color.
dialogues.text: She bit her lip so hard that it changed color.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはお兄ちゃんのために帰ってきたんだ」
上げられた顔には意志の強さがあった。
dialogues.en: She looked strong as she lifted her face.
dialogues.text: She looked strong as she lifted her face.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「一週間……ううん、５日間だけ待って」
dialogues.en: "Wait for me, for a week...... no, five days."
dialogues.text: "Wait for me, for a week...... no, five days."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "So five days from now is the thirteenth."
dialogues.text: "So five days from now is the thirteenth."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "You need to be ready by then."
dialogues.text: "You need to be ready by then."

dialogues.jp: 問いただそうとしたときだった――。
dialogues.en: As I try to ask her......
dialogues.text: As I try to ask her......

dialogues.jp: どこからか音夢の声がした。
dialogues.en: I heard Nemu calling for me.
dialogues.text: I heard Nemu calling for me.

dialogues.jp:
夢の中に現れたさくらに、音夢と仲良くしてい
ることを怒られてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Sakura showed up in my dream and she was upset that I was
still in love with Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Sakura showed up in my dream and she was upset that I was
still in love with Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
だが、ふたりの気持ちが抑えきれないことを知
ると、さくらは５日後にある手段を用いると呟
いた。
dialogues.en:
But, as she realized we couldn't stop each other, she
mumbled she'll do something in five days.
dialogues.text:
But, as she realized we couldn't stop each other, she
mumbled she'll do something in five days.

dialogues.en: And she told me to get ready for it.
dialogues.text: And she told me to get ready for it.
